items.title: "Wooden Joe" Nicholas Interview, 1956-11-12
items.q: Lil Frank Lewis was a sharp old guy. You really didn't think he might have been? I didn't think he might have been.

ctx.x: Oh, George Lewis or that Frank Lewis you mean?
Frank Lewis, yeah. Frank Lewis. Frank Lewis. Well, that's two Lewis. I didn't know George was playing back then. And then George Lewis played something like Frank Lewis.
